release_read.basis: Q3 beat its own guide clearly (revenue $46.5M vs $43.5M consensus, adj. EBITDA $5.4M vs $1-2M guide, cash up to $43.6M), but the Q4 guide of $38-40M revenue and ~$1M EBITDA carries the Academic run-off slope forward exactly as the thesis expected; on a name that trades the guide, a slightly negative close-to-close read, softened by the beat and the cash cushion.

release.headline: Chegg Q3 2026: revenue $46.5M (-40% y/y), adj. EBITDA $5.4M, FCF $5.5M, cash $43.6M, no debt; Q4 guide revenue $38-40M, GM 46-48%, adj. EBITDA ~$1M
release.release_time_note: Exhibit 99.1 to an 8-K dated 2026-11-03 (GlobeNewswire dateline); exact time not stated in the exhibit; bmo per the pick.

vs_bar.metric: adj. EBITDA vs company guide midpoint

key_line.detail: Revenue $38-40M (midpoint $39M, -16% q/q vs the $46.5M Q3 actual), GM 46-48%, adj. EBITDA ~$1M: the breakeven-EBITDA, sub-$40M run-rate the hunt extrapolated. No Q4 consensus was found to measure it against (hunt: none on any terminal); no Skilling/Academic split or subscriber count disclosed in the release.

guidance.detail: Sequentially lower Q4 guide ($38-40M revenue, ~$1M EBITDA) vs the Q3 actual; no full-year revenue/EBITDA guide; against the street it is unmeasurable (no sourced Q4 consensus). Capex cut >60% for 2026 reiterated; no new buyback, no reverse split mentioned.

call.detail: Call time not stated in the exhibit (webcast at investor.chegg.com); could not confirm whether it has happened. If it is during the session, it is a risk an early exit avoids.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions, wire headlines on the reaction or retail tone found by 09:18 ET; a single analyst covers the name.

tape_read.note: Robust reference $0.66 (-1.5% vs $0.67 close) against a last print of $0.7135 (+6.5%) and a range of $0.645-$0.80: the pre-market swung both ways on 20 prints, only 2 in the last 30 min, last print 08:42, stale_at_open true. The reference sits close to the -2% release read, well inside the ~13.6% historical move, so roughly fair but with a very unreliable reading.

thesis_check.note: The Q4 guide lands where the thesis said (sub-$40M revenue, ~$1M EBITDA), but the Q3 beat (+7% revenue, EBITDA 3-4x the guide, cash rising to $43.6M against a ~$74M market cap) is larger than the hunt assumed and cushions it.

expected.open_lag_note: Stale, two-sided pre-market (last print 08:42, range -3.7% to +19.4%) on a sub-dollar, $0.5M/day name makes the open close to a coin flip around the -1.5% reference; a bmo print with a weak guide may keep repricing lower through the session but a strong beat and net cash argue the other way.

recommendation.limit_basis: Cover limit at $0.65: below both the robust reference ($0.66) and the last print ($0.7135), inside the pre-market range (low $0.645), about -3% vs the $0.67 close, i.e. just beyond the -2% the release supports; about 8% below the $0.7061 entry. Thin sub-dollar name, so a limit avoids paying the spread at an unreliable open; unfilled it goes at the close, consistent with a bmo print that tends to keep repricing.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn gemengd: het derde kwartaal was duidelijk beter dan verwacht, maar de vooruitzichten voor het vierde kwartaal zijn zwak, precies zoals de short-these voorspelde. De handel voor de opening is dun en geeft geen betrouwbare koers, dus we zetten een kooplimiet op $0,65 om de short te sluiten als de koers daar komt; lukt dat niet, dan sluiten we aan het einde van de dag.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 duidelijk boven $0,75 handelt met meerdere transacties, of als er een koopadvies of overnamenieuws verschijnt, dan direct bij de opening sluiten.
